title: Walzee
tagline: Walzee is a way to curate content and make revenue from people following you for the content you're curating
description: Walzee is a way to curate content and make revenue from people following you for the content you're curating. As a curator, you can have a direct link with your community and share them alpha and they will pay to follow you. You will be able to share any content you like (articles, videos, url, ...)
how_its_made: Walzee is react app where you can connect with your Lens profile, you can set up a follow module and choose the amount associated to a follow. As a follower you can go on the page of your favorite curator and pay to follow him. The goal was to setup a back end and talk to Lens through it.
